goal: Add a real-time notification system so Jarvis can push alerts to the user when long-running agent tasks complete
summary: Implement a Server-Sent Events (SSE) endpoint on the API server to push real-time notifications to the frontend when long-running agent tasks complete. The backend will emit events from the existing agent/task execution pipeline via a shared event bus, and the frontend will consume them using a dedicated React hook, surfacing alerts through the existing NotificationToast component.

recommendedFiles.reason: New SSE route (GET /api/notifications/stream) that clients subscribe to for real-time push events. Manages SSE connection lifecycle and writes events from the notification event bus.
Shared in-process EventEmitter-based bus that decouples producers (agent task completion, autoLoop, autonomy cycles) from SSE consumers. Provides typed emit/subscribe API.
Register the new notifications router so /api/notifications/stream is mounted and reachable.
Emit a 'task:complete' or 'task:failed' event to notificationBus when agent task executions finish, providing task id, status, and summary payload.
React hook that opens an EventSource connection to /api/notifications/stream, parses incoming events, and exposes a notifications array plus a dismiss callback.
Already exists as a component; wire it to consume notifications from useNotificationStream and render real-time agent alerts.
Mount the useNotificationStream hook at the top-level Dashboard so notifications are available globally across all panels.

affectedSystems.name: Agent Task Execution Pipeline
affectedSystems.reason: executionEngine and agentActionExecutor must emit events on task completion/failure, coupling them to the new notificationBus.

affectedSystems.name: API Server Routing
affectedSystems.reason: A persistent SSE connection changes server resource usage patterns; the Express server must handle long-lived HTTP connections without timeout interference.

affectedSystems.name: Frontend Notification UX
affectedSystems.reason: NotificationToast and Dashboard are updated to surface real-time alerts, affecting the primary user-facing interaction surface.

affectedSystems.name: AutoLoop / Autonomy Systems
affectedSystems.reason: autoLoop and autonomy cycle completions are good candidates for secondary notification events, requiring minor emit calls in autoLoop.ts and autonomyController.

implementationPlan.title: Create the notificationBus module
implementationPlan.description: Implement a typed EventEmitter singleton in artifacts/api-server/src/lib/notificationBus.ts. Define a NotificationEvent interface with fields: id (uuid), type ('task:complete' | 'task:failed' | 'autonomy:cycle-done' | 'info'), title, message, timestamp, and optional metadata. Export emit() and subscribe() helpers.

implementationPlan.title: Add SSE notifications route
implementationPlan.description: Create artifacts/api-server/src/routes/notifications.ts with GET /api/notifications/stream. Set headers (Content-Type: text/event-stream, Cache-Control: no-cache, Connection: keep-alive). Subscribe to notificationBus and write 'data: <json>\n\n' for each event. Clean up subscription on client disconnect (req.on('close')). Send a heartbeat comment every 30 seconds to prevent proxy timeouts.

implementationPlan.title: Register the notifications route in the router index
implementationPlan.description: Import and mount the notifications router in artifacts/api-server/src/routes/index.ts under the path /api/notifications.

implementationPlan.title: Emit events from the execution engine
implementationPlan.description: In artifacts/api-server/src/lib/executionEngine.ts, import notificationBus and call emit() with a 'task:complete' or 'task:failed' event after an agent task finishes. Include the task id, name/title, and final status. Optionally add a similar emit in autoLoop.ts on loop-tick completion for 'info' events.

implementationPlan.title: Create the useNotificationStream React hook
implementationPlan.description: Implement artifacts/jarvas/src/hooks/useNotificationStream.ts using the browser EventSource API pointed at /api/notifications/stream. Parse JSON event data, accumulate notifications in useState, and expose { notifications, dismiss(id) }. Handle reconnect on error with exponential backoff. Return a cleanup function that closes the EventSource.

implementationPlan.title: Wire NotificationToast to the stream and mount at Dashboard
implementationPlan.description: In Dashboard.tsx, call useNotificationStream() and pass the notifications list to NotificationToast. Modify NotificationToast.tsx to accept a notifications prop (or read from a context) and render a stacked toast list with auto-dismiss after 6 seconds and a manual close button.

implementationPlan.title: Extend to autonomy and plan completions
implementationPlan.description: Add notificationBus.emit() calls in autonomyController when a cycle completes or stops, and in planner/executor when a plan finishes. Use the 'autonomy:cycle-done' type so the frontend can optionally render distinct styling.

risks.description: SSE connections are persistent; many simultaneous browser tabs or clients could exhaust server file descriptors or memory if the subscriber list is not bounded.
risks.mitigation: Cap max concurrent SSE clients (e.g. 50) in the route handler and reject new connections with 503 when the limit is reached. Log active connection count.

risks.description: The in-process EventEmitter notificationBus only works in a single-process deployment. If the API server is ever clustered or multi-process, events won't propagate across workers.
risks.mitigation: Document the single-process constraint clearly. For future scaling, design the bus interface so it can be swapped for a Redis pub/sub adapter without changing consumers.

risks.description: Reverse proxies (nginx, Replit's routing layer) may buffer SSE responses or enforce request timeouts that disconnect the stream prematurely.
risks.mitigation: Send a comment-only heartbeat (':\n\n') every 25-30 seconds. Set X-Accel-Buffering: no header. Implement client-side automatic reconnect in useNotificationStream.

risks.description: Modifying executionEngine to emit events could introduce side effects or errors that inadvertently suppress task completion logic if the emit call throws.
risks.mitigation: Wrap all notificationBus.emit() calls in try/catch so notification failures never affect the primary execution flow.

validationPlan.description: Ensure NotificationEvent types are consistent across notificationBus, the SSE route, and the frontend hook with no implicit any.
Unit test notificationBus: verify emit() triggers subscribers with correct payload and cleanup unsubscribes properly.
Open the Jarvas Dashboard in a browser, trigger a long-running agent task via AgentActionsPanel or DevAgentPanel, and verify a toast notification appears within 2 seconds of task completion.
Open two browser tabs simultaneously and confirm both receive the same notification events. Close one tab and verify the server cleanly removes its SSE subscriber.
Use curl to subscribe to /api/notifications/stream, then POST to /api/agent-actions/:id/execute and verify a 'task:complete' SSE event is received within the expected timeframe.
Run linter across new and modified files to ensure code style consistency.
